verdict.rationale: Claude Code's MCP integration explicitly supports connecting to hundreds of external tools and partner-built servers (e.g., Notion's official MCP endpoint, Jira, Slack, GitHub/GitLab), and the Agent SDK lets teams build/embed their own or partner agents into Claude Code workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of specific partner-agent integrations working end-to-end and any marketplace/directory of certified partner agent apps.
